## QC

Policy: `docs/quality/QC.md`. Every row needs evidence, or "Not applicable" with a reason. Identify people by GitHub
handle and role (handles without `@` unless you mean to notify), never by personal name.

| Track | Applies? | Evidence, or why not applicable | Reviewer, tester or approver (GitHub handle, role) | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Code review | Yes | | | |
| Independent calculation review | | Calculations changed: | | |
| Business UAT | | Shared, feedback, dispositions, acceptance decision: | | |
| Technical UAT | | Acceptance issues: | | |

**Calculation changes:** pooling, denominators or populations, snapshot selection, flag summaries, scaling or rounding.
List each, or write "none".

**Earlier acceptance affected:** acceptance or reviews this change invalidates, and how each is reassessed. Or "none".

**Outstanding decisions:** open questions, deferred findings or pending sign-offs. Or "none".
